tut_2de1f827ad32d7c4.text: Archetypes are quick way to create a character. They are pre-generated characters with attributes and skills tuned around a specific function. They are ready to select and play. You are not locked to this archetype and can grow your character however you wish.
tut_2de1f827ad32d7c4.speaker: Tutorial

tut_446f86e6485c9c0a.text: Etiquette is about knowing how to behave in various social situations. The right etiquette can give you an edge in certain conversations. Choose an Etiquette from the list below. Choosing an Etiquette does not cost karma, and each Etiquette can only be chosen once.
tut_446f86e6485c9c0a.speaker: Tutorial

tut_d1260c1b85679964.text: If you feel comfortable with the way characters are built in Shadowrun, you may create your own character by mixing skills and attributes as you wish.
tut_d1260c1b85679964.speaker: Tutorial

tut_3a34ef573da647a0.text: In the world of Shadowrun, there are no statistical differences between males and females.
tut_3a34ef573da647a0.speaker: Tutorial

tut_98e448463e42814c.text: It is time for you to pick a spirit totem. The choice is permanent, so choose wisely.
tut_98e448463e42814c.speaker: Tutorial

tut_51d80195e39a5fdc.text: Karma represents the experience characters earn while running the shadows and achieving goals. Karma is used to improve Attributes and Skills. An Attribute or Skill rating can be increased by spending Karma equal to the next increment of that rating. Thus, improving your Body from 4 to 5 requires you to spend 5 Karma points. You have some karma available now to customize your character.
tut_51d80195e39a5fdc.speaker: Tutorial

tut_6556480114015584.text: Mage Aura allows you to see into the veil, eventually allowing you to see directly into the Essence of a being.
tut_6556480114015584.speaker: Tutorial

tut_d394308e722a2fcb.text: Many runners use a streetname, handle, or working name - names like "Half-Jack" or "Lady Z". Others stick with their given name, or adopt a nickname. Please choose a name for your character.
tut_d394308e722a2fcb.speaker: Tutorial

tut_b37be95bbd4a5ea4.text: Since the Awakening in 2012, five races have come to be considered metahuman. The races that now make up the world are Dwarf, Elf, Human, Ork, and Troll.
tut_b37be95bbd4a5ea4.speaker: Tutorial

tut_358de65235afd20e.text: Use the arrows to change your portrait and model to customize your shadowrunner.
tut_358de65235afd20e.speaker: Tutorial

tut_d08ff9b2cadc25d9.text: WARNING: You can still hire more runners. Do you want to continue anyways?
tut_d08ff9b2cadc25d9.speaker: Tutorial

tut_aa158b5edcdb79ad.text: You cannot spend karma while in conversation. Try again when out of conversation.
tut_aa158b5edcdb79ad.speaker: Tutorial

tut_d2a819bbbd797488.text: You have Karma available to improve your character's Attributes and Skills. Open the Karma screen?
tut_d2a819bbbd797488.speaker: Tutorial

tut_60e1571cdcb689f1.text: You have unspent Karma. Are you sure you want to finish character creation and start the game? You may spend Karma later at any time by accessing the character screen.
tut_60e1571cdcb689f1.speaker: Tutorial

tut_1324713bb7a40ec5.text: Are you sure you want to restart this level? You will lose any unsaved progress.
tut_1324713bb7a40ec5.speaker: Tutorial
